thesis.observe: BTC $82,697, ETH $2,434, SOL $104.86, HYPE $78.43. HL total OI $11.74B (z30 +1.26), BTC OI down 2.6% from the prior reading, BTC funding about zero (z30 -1.06), HYPE funding z30 -3.10, Fear & Greed 68 (z30 +2.43). hl-cycles: mild risk-on since Oct 9 (allocation 66%), 2 of 6 stress conditions on (STH-SOPR 7d mean below 1, stablecoin supply falling over 30d), Compass 46.3 Neutral, Macro 28.1 Restrictive; feed refreshed within the hour. BTC is 2.9% above the ETF cost basis per hl-cycles ($81.7K) and 6.1% above the True Market Mean ($79.2K). 10Y 5.12% (Oct 20), Brent $115.22, VIX 16.68, stablecoins $303.8B (7d -0.57%).
thesis.infer: Price held while OI fell and funding is near zero, so we read a mild unwind rather than crowded carry; HYPE is the exception, with negative funding at z30 -3.10 suggesting shorts are leaning on it. Consensus is pricing a hold or a small hike probability for Oct 28 (reported 44-51% after CPI); we read the risk as hawkish given the 10Y above 5% and Brent above $110. The disagreement: Fear & Greed is stretched (z30 +2.43) and hl-cycles reads risk-on, while stablecoin supply is shrinking and the Macro lens is Restrictive, so risk skews toward a sentiment-led advance that is fragile if the dollar firms.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC holds above the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close below $81.7K breaks it and is hl-cycles' stated invalidation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below the True Market Mean ($79.2K) could put the STH cost basis ($74.6K) in play, more likely with a hawkish surprise. Second tail case (low-confidence): a dovish hold with oil under $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and support a move toward the Mean MVRV price ($105.7K), far overhead.
